note: Sheet number printed top-LEFT (not top-right). Railroad tracks (G.W. Co's Terminal Track, G.C.&S.F. R.R.) run along left edge beside Av A/Water. Fire-limits dashed line along 19th St. City Hall & City Market block on 20th St; Texas Star Flour Mill lower left. Scale bar bottom center-left. Compass rose top center.

Sheet number top-left. Fire-limits line jogs through the Av D/19th St blocks. Grand Opera House & Hotel Grand, Masonic Temple, First Presbyterian Church, St. Mary's R.C. Cathedral and School. Scale bar bottom center. Compass rose top center.

Sheet number top-left. Dense downtown wholesale district, nearly solid brick (pink). Cotton Exchange and Galveston News on 21st/Centre row; National Biscuit Co and Crescent Milling elevator along Av A. Railroad tracks along left edge. Small red-circled numerals (212, 213) mid-sheet are symbol markers, not sheet refs. Scale bar bottom center.

Sheet number top-left. Tremont Hotel (with 10,000-gal cistern), Harmony Hall, Engine House No. 1, Southwestern Telegraph & Telephone building, Fourth Presbyterian Church. Compass rose top right. Scale bar bottom center-left.

Sheet number top-left. Union Passenger Depot with the gray Galveston Union Depot & Terminal Co. iron train shed running vertically through the center-left blocks; fanned railroad tracks lower left. Fire-limits line along 25th/Rosenberg. P.J. Willis & Bro wholesale grocery, Welch & Cleary foundry. Scale bar bottom center.

Sheet number printed top-RIGHT. U.S. Post Office & Custom House occupies its own block (Av F/25th-26th); Brush Electric Light & Power Co power house and C. Hildenbrand planing mill below 26th; Mascot Theatre, Central Hotel. Fire-limits lines along 25th/Rosenberg and vertically near 24th blocks. Compass rose mid right. Scale bar bottom left.

Sheet number top-left. Bottom-left edge numeral prints as a bare '0' - almost certainly '20' with the 2 not inked. Large cotton press compounds: East Yard press (block 628) and Shippers Press yard (629) plus Shippers Press South Yard (569); Wm. T. Lemp Brewing Co top left; Moore & Goodman Lumber Yard; several blocks along Av A/B empty. Railroad tracks along left edge and crossing top center. Scale bar bottom left.

Sheet number printed top-RIGHT. Bottom row dominated by two idle Factors Press compounds ('not used, going to ruin' / 'not running') and a vacant Cotton Yard block; otherwise small frame dwellings. Compass rose top left. Scale bar bottom left.

Sheet number top-left. Left third is the Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe R.R. freight yards (freight houses, many track lines, largely unbuilt blocks); right-edge ref '20' overprints the Av E label; left-edge and bottom-left refs print as bare '0', likely '20' with the 2 under-inked. Galveston Warehouse Co press yard, Merchants & Planters Compress west yard, gas holders and city gas works block 512. Compass rose mid left. Scale bar bottom left.

Sheet number printed top-RIGHT. City Pump House & Reservoir block (iron reservoir 1,175,000 gals, standpipe) top right; Galveston Houston & Northern R.R. cotton yard top left; Gulf City Press north yard with cotton sheds; C.B. Lee & Co Iron Works; two gasholders lower left; several blocks vacant. Scale bar bottom left.
